6.343 rsNestedAggregateInFilterExpression
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsNestedAggregateInFilterExpression is a critical error that will occur when an aggregate function
located in a Filter expression refers to another aggregate function in its Expression parameter.
